# Madlanga Commission to hear new witness testimony

![File: Chairperson and commissioners at the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry in Pretoria.](https://www.sabcnews.com/sabcnews/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Madlanga-2-866x577.jpg)

*   File: Chairperson and commissioners at the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry in Pretoria.

*   Image Credits :
*   SABC News

Sibahle Motha

*   11 May 2026, 06:10 \[SAST\]

[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sabcnews.com%2Fsabcnews%2Fmadlanga-commission-to-hear-new-witness-testimony%2F "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Madlanga%20Commission%20to%20hear%20new%20witness%20testimony&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sabcnews.com%2Fsabcnews%2Fmadlanga-commission-to-hear-new-witness-testimony%2F "X")[](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text=Madlanga%20Commission%20to%20hear%20new%20witness%20testimony%20https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sabcnews.com%2Fsabcnews%2Fmadlanga-commission-to-hear-new-witness-testimony%2F "Whatsapp")[](https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sabcnews.com%2Fsabcnews%2Fmadlanga-commission-to-hear-new-witness-testimony%2F "Linkedin")

A new witness is expected to testify before the Madlanga Commission on Monday morning, as the inquiry continues hearing evidence relating to drug seizures by South African law enforcement agencies.

This week’s proceedings follow testimony heard last week concerning the alleged drug theft at the Hawks offices in Port Shepstone, KwaZulu-Natal.

[Witnesses have detailed how 541 kilograms of drugs were allegedly stolen from the premises in November 2021.](https://www.sabcnews.com/sabcnews/flynn-tells-madlanga-commission-of-irregularities-in-exhibit-transfer/?hilite=madlanga+commission)

Commission spokesperson Jeremy Michaels says the inquiry will focus on developments in Gauteng, as investigations continue into allegations of corruption and criminal infiltration in the criminal justice system.

# Madlanga Commission: New witness to testify privately on drug theft at Hawks offices

Topic Timeline

[![Alpha Ramushwana](https://media-cache.primedia-service.com/media/UserAvatars/0ea33b07360716e4f208a89bd0c5d076851beadf.png)

Alpha Ramushwana

8 May 2026 | 4:03

](/author/Alpha Ramushwana)

## He is expected to lead evidence on the 2021 theft of 542 kilograms of cocaine from the Hawks offices in Port Shepstone.

*   [Madlanga Commission of Inquiry](/tag/Madlanga Commission of Inquiry)
*   [Drugs](/tag/Drugs)
*   [Directorate for Priority Crime Investigation (Hawks)](/tag/Directorate for Priority Crime Investigation \(Hawks\))

The judicial commission of inquiry into corruption within the criminal justice system held a media briefing in Sandton, Johannesburg on 28 July 2025. Picture: Katlego Jiyane/EWN

Proceedings at the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry will take place behind closed doors on Friday after a witness applied to testify in camera.

The witness, who will testify under the pseudonym Witness H, is expected to take the stand.

The public and the media will not have access to his visual identity or voice for the duration of his testimony.

He is expected to lead evidence on the 2021 theft of 542 kilograms of cocaine from the Hawks' offices in Port Shepstone.

**ALSO READ**

**[Madlanga Commission hears evidence of missing drug haul](https://www.ewn.co.za/2026/05/18/madlanga-commission-hears-evidence-of-grinded-safes-and-missing-drug-haul)**

**[Madlanga Commission: New witness sheds light on drug theft at Hawks KZN offices](https://www.ewn.co.za/2026/05/07/madlanga-commission-new-witness-sheds-light-on-drug-theft-at-hawks-kzn-offices)**

The past two witnesses at the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry have emphasised several irregularities in the Hawks’ handling of the confiscated cocaine worth R200 million.

The commission heard that the cocaine was never supposed to be stored at the Hawks’ offices and that the drugs were also never taken to the Forensic Science Laboratory for testing and destruction.

Retired Hawks officer Jakobus Prinsloo told the commission’s co-chairperson, Advocate Sandile Khumalo, that the Hawks' storage facility was not equipped to safely store such a large quantity of drugs.

Khumalo posed a question to Prinsloo, "You didn’t say either we increase security or you take your consignment because it’s not safe in my office?"

Prinsloo said, "I didn’t do that, commissioner."
